title: BoardSafety: AI-Ready Data from Manufacturer Documentation for Development-Board Safety
abstract: arXiv:2610.33448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The development of large language models (LLMs) are capable to assist with hardware experiments. In this scenario, this raises a practical question: Can LLMs determine whether a proposed operation is safe for a specific development board? Documented operating limits and safety requirements are board-specific, even across products from the same manufacturer. This variation makes board-specific safety judgments by an LLM difficult to evaluate. To address this problem, we introduce the BoardSafety Benchmark. The benchmark is built from vendor datasheets and hardware guides. For data transformation, these documents are converted into a board-specific safety rule base and are then used to create labeled operating scenarios. Each data item pairs a board and a proposed operation to an applicable safety rule with ground-truth label, indicating the level of safety. The categorized level for each operation includes safe, unsafe, or insufficient-in

translated_title: BoardSafety：基于制造商文档构建的面向开发板安全的AI就绪数据
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）的发展使其能够辅助硬件实验。在此背景下，产生了一个实际问题：LLM能否判断某项拟议操作对特定开发板是否安全？文档中记载的操作限制和安全要求是针对特定板卡的，即使是同一制造商的不同产品之间也存在差异。这种差异性使得LLM进行板卡特定的安全判断难以评估。为解决这一问题，我们提出了BoardSafety基准。该基准基于厂商数据手册和硬件指南构建。在数据转换方面，这些文档被转换为针对特定板卡的安全规则库，并随后用于创建带标注的操作场景。每个数据项将一块开发板和一个拟议操作与适用的安全规则及真实标签配对，用于指示安全等级。每个操作的安全等级分类包括：安全、不安全或信息不足（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出了BoardSafety基准，通过将厂商数据手册和硬件指南转换为板卡特定的安全规则库，构建了带标注的操作场景数据集，用于评估大语言模型判断开发板操作安全性的能力。
en_tdlr: Introduces the BoardSafety Benchmark, which converts vendor datasheets and hardware guides into board-specific safety rule bases to create labeled operating scenarios for evaluating LLMs' ability to judge the safety of proposed operations on development boards.
